coverage.finding: The folio number '251' with superscript 'b' is at the top left. The reading matches the source.
The c.92(1) line and its right-hand column 'n.d: 82:9/12: D.' are present. The tick is in the left margin. The underdots on 'Visnupurāṇa' remain cursive and uncertain.
The struck-through 'i.4.41, to v.17' is preserved as cancelled text. 'an old MS.' is in fainter writing. The right-hand column reads 'n-d: 62:10: D.'

The entry and the faint 'An old MS.' are present. The left-pointing arrow at roughly [3094,800,170,45] ends at 'n.d. :105:10: D'. Its tail crosses toward the fol. 252 margin note 'C92(1)to(4)'. The arrow is recorded in an annotation.
The c.92(4) entry and 'n.d.: 38: 11/14: D.' are present.

Both lines are present. The small mark between 'Do ,' and '+ co.' is annotated. So is the small ink mark below the start of line 2, near [520,1225,45,60]. The date figures and '(in. 63, 64)' remain uncertain.
'(ff. 3-4 of MS.)' sits above 'ff. unf.' and is placed at the caret before 'Begins:'. The attachment by caret is visible.
Both lines of the c.19(1) entry, the cancelled word and '[sic]' are present. The right-hand figure reads 'n-1. : 2 : 11 : D'; its first element is ambiguous.
The pencil '(complete)' is above the note, with an upward caret or arrow after 'ff. 2-7'.
The pencil note is present and has no shelfmark of its own. A pencil arrow '← ·—' at about y 3640 crosses the binding string from the fol. 252 side, where it stands at √c.386(7).

after.evidence: The fol. 252 margin note 'C92(1)to(4)' stands beside a ditto line under the Visnu Purāṇa heading. The connecting arrow physically ends at the c.92(3) right-hand column (b004), not at this line, so the link to c.92(1) rests on the range '(1)to(4)' written in the note.

review.boundary_review: Writing to the right of the binding string (x>~3180) belongs to fol. 252 and is excluded. This includes 'c.', 'Su', 'C92(1)to(4) c', '√d.', '√c.', '√d.', 'd.', the stray 'd'/'c' letters, ticks and the arrows. Only the arrow heads entering this page are noted as attachment evidence. The relationships of b004 and b010 to fol. 252 remain probable, and that of b008 remains uncertain.

region_review.top: Folio number and the four c.92 entries. No further text.
region_review.middle: The C.116-117 entry, then blank ruled paper down to the c.19(1) entry at y~2900-3030. The binding knot near y~2680 is not writing.
region_review.bottom: The pencil note at y~3590-3700. Below it are only a faint smudge near the bottom rule, small specks, and a dot around y~4450. No bottom note was found.
region_review.left_margin: Ticks before c.92(1)-(4) only. No other marginal writing.
region_review.right_margin: The right-hand columns of the entries, and arrows at b004 and b010 crossing from the fol. 252 side.
region_review.interlinear: '(ff. 3-4 of MS.)' above c.19(1), '(complete)' above the pencil note, and the small marks in C.116-117. All are accounted for.
